problem_text:
A logistics firm must coordinate a series of inter-facility quality audits across ten distinct manufacturing plants.  

The travel durations between plants, measured in minutes, are as follows:  
* Plant Alpha to Plant Beta: 99.8 minutes  
* Plant Alpha to Plant Gamma: 33.0 minutes  
* Plant Alpha to Plant Delta: 8.5 minutes  
* Plant Alpha to Plant Epsilon: 131.0 minutes  
* Plant Alpha to Plant Zeta: 69.3 minutes  
* Plant Alpha to Plant Eta: 174.2 minutes  
* Plant Alpha to Plant Theta: 73.8 minutes  
* Plant Alpha to Plant Iota: 64.2 minutes  
* Plant Alpha to Plant Kappa: 126.6 minutes  
* Plant Beta to Plant Gamma: 81.2 minutes  
* Plant Beta to Plant Delta: 107.5 minutes  
* Plant Beta to Plant Epsilon: 50.2 minutes  
* Plant Beta to Plant Zeta: 30.8 minutes  
* Plant Beta to Plant Eta: 78.8 minutes  
* Plant Beta to Plant Theta: 95.4 minutes  
* Plant Beta to Plant Iota: 50.3 minutes  
* Plant Beta to Plant Kappa: 27.0 minutes  
* Plant Gamma to Plant Delta: 36.1 minutes  
* Plant Gamma to Plant Epsilon: 122.1 minutes  
* Plant Gamma to Plant Zeta: 54.2 minutes  
* Plant Gamma to Plant Eta: 148.9 minutes  
* Plant Gamma to Plant Theta: 91.4 minutes  
* Plant Gamma to Plant Iota: 63.0 minutes  
* Plant Gamma to Plant Kappa: 108.0 minutes  
* Plant Delta to Plant Epsilon: 139.5 minutes  
* Plant Delta to Plant Zeta: 77.1 minutes  
* Plant Delta to Plant Eta: 180.9 minutes  
* Plant Delta to Plant Theta: 80.8 minutes  
* Plant Delta to Plant Iota: 72.7 minutes  
* Plant Delta to Plant Kappa: 134.3 minutes  
* Plant Epsilon to Plant Zeta: 68.1 minutes  
* Plant Epsilon to Plant Eta: 91.8 minutes  
* Plant Epsilon to Plant Theta: 94.3 minutes  
* Plant Epsilon to Plant Iota: 67.5 minutes  
* Plant Epsilon to Plant Kappa: 40.0 minutes  
* Plant Zeta to Plant Eta: 108.2 minutes  
* Plant Zeta to Plant Theta: 73.9 minutes  
* Plant Zeta to Plant Iota: 27.2 minutes  
* Plant Zeta to Plant Kappa: 57.3 minutes  
* Plant Eta to Plant Theta: 171.9 minutes  
* Plant Eta to Plant Iota: 128.8 minutes  
* Plant Eta to Plant Kappa: 58.8 minutes  
* Plant Theta to Plant Iota: 47.0 minutes  
* Plant Theta to Plant Kappa: 113.5 minutes  
* Plant Iota to Plant Kappa: 72.4 minutes  

The objective is to determine the audit tour of minimal total duration, such that each plant is visited precisely once before returning to the initial facility.
